## Description

Clicking an empty slot opens the booking panel for that doctor/resource and time; select or register a patient, visit type (sets length), reason category (free-text reason never shown on reception screens beyond category), channel. A slot hold (default 2 minutes) reserves the slot while the receptionist completes the form; confirmation creates the appointment and triggers the confirmation message (MDV-P1-032).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Opening the booking panel creates a hold; another user trying the same slot sees it as "being booked" and cannot confirm it.
- [ ] **AC2.** Holds expire automatically after the configured time and the slot becomes free.
- [ ] **AC3.** A booking for an unavailable column (doctor not working) is impossible from UI and API.
- [ ] **AC4.** Booking writes AppointmentBooked.v1 (no PHI) and an audit event; the appointment appears on the board in Booked.
- [ ] **AC5.** Booking API p95 < 300 ms under the P1 load profile (MDV-P1-037).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
